# Why are a tree and a person so different inside?

## The same levels

A neem tree and a person are organised in the same way. In both, cells form tissues, tissues form organs, and organs work together in the whole organism.

## Different tissues

Yet the tissues inside them are very different. A tree trunk holds tissues that support the tree and carry water and food. Your upper arm holds skin, muscle, bone, nerves and blood vessels.

**The levels of organisation are shared, but the tissues are not.** Why do a tree and a person have such different tissues? The next lesson answers this.
